title: Factory policy (policies/default.yaml, .factory/policy.yaml)
description: A product policy can only tighten the default: limits take the lower value, lists are added to.

max_attempts.description: Build attempts per item before it is blocked.

max_tokens_per_item.description: Tokens per item, all steps and attempts.

check_rounds_in_session.description: Times a builder is sent back by the checks inside its session before it may finish; 0 turns it off.

denied_commands.description: Command prefixes no agent may run.

approval_paths.description: Glob patterns. An item whose diff touches one is flagged for the user's attention before approval.

protected_paths.description: Glob patterns no agent may change. A diff that touches one blocks the item.

sensitive_paths.description: Glob patterns. An item that touches one needs the owner's approval of its plan and of its change.

test_paths.description: Glob patterns of test files. Deleting one or adding a skip to one sends the item back.

secret_patterns.description: Extra regular expressions. Added lines that match one are never committed.

local_binding.description: Let sandboxed processes listen and connect on loopback. On macOS this reaches every local port of the host, so it is off unless a product needs it (.NET test runs do).
